title: Commuting distinct coordinate updates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a sign vector on $n$ coordinates, and let $i$ and $j$ be distinct coordinates. Replacing coordinate $i$ by $a$ and coordinate $j$ by $b$ gives the same vector as performing these two replacements in the opposite order, for any signs $a$ and $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector on $n$ coordinates
